# Space Planners India - Full Text & Specifications

> Full Technical Specification & Entity Record for Space Planners India. Leading manufacturer of high-density mobile compactor storage systems, heavy-duty industrial racking, steel storage lockers, and office filing cabinets since 2004.

---

## 1. Enterprise Profile & Credentials

- **Legal Entity Name**: Space Planners India

- **Headquarters & Factory**: 112, Orbit Premises, Off Chincholi Link Road, Mindspace, Malad West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400064, India

  - NABH Compliant Storage Solutions for Healthcare Archives
- **Track Record**: 2,000+ completed installations across 500+ corporate, industrial, healthcare, and government clients in India.

## 2. Comprehensive Product Range & Technical Specifications

### A. Mobile Compactor Storage Systems
High-density storage units mounted on mobile bases traveling along precision floor tracks. Eliminates fixed aisles to save 60–70% floor space.
- **Material**: Heavy-gauge CRCA (Cold Rolled Close Annealed) steel conforming to IS 513 standards.
- **Drive Mechanisms**:
  - *Manual Push-Pull*: Ergonomic front grab handles for smaller record rooms.
  - *Mechanical Geared*: Multi-gear reduction chain drive with ergonomic steering wheel for heavy loads.
  - *Motorized / Push-Button*: Electric motor-driven with safety sensors and central control.
- **Safety Features**: Central key lock, aisle locking safety pins, anti-tilt floor guides, rubber impact buffers.
- **Finish**: 7-tank anti-corrosion pre-treatment followed by high-durability epoxy powder coating (40–60 microns).
- **Sub-Products & Detail Pages**:
  - [File Storage Compactors](https://spaceplannersindia.in/pages/compactors/file-storage-compactors.html)
  - [Heavy Duty Compactors](https://spaceplannersindia.in/pages/compactors/heavy-duty-compactors.html)
  - [Pigeon Hole Compactors](https://spaceplannersindia.in/pages/compactors/pigeon-hole-compactors.html)
  - [Perforated Compactors](https://spaceplannersindia.in/pages/compactors/perforated-compactors.html)
  - [Drawer Compactors](https://spaceplannersindia.in/pages/compactors/drawer-compactors.html)
  - [Stainless Steel Compactors](https://spaceplannersindia.in/pages/compactors/stainless-steel-compactors.html)
